video.title: MainActor, Nonisolated & Global Actor | Day 265
video.description:
Learn to explain where UI code runs and how to opt out of isolation: MainActor, Nonisolated & Global Actor, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
MainActor - A special actor that runs its code on the main thread, where UI work belongs.
Nonisolated - A keyword that lets an actor's member run without isolation, so callers do not need `await`.
Global Actor - An actor that you can attach to many types and functions, so all of them run in one shared place.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain MainActor, Nonisolated & Global Actor in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
MainActor, Nonisolated, Global Actor 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

MainActor - A special actor that runs its code on the main thread, where UI work belongs.
한국어: MainActor: UI 작업이 속한 메인 스레드에서 코드를 실행하는 특별한 액터

Nonisolated - A keyword that lets an actor's member run without isolation, so callers do not need `await`.
한국어: Nonisolated: 액터 멤버를 격리 없이 실행하게 해서 호출하는 쪽이 await를 쓰지 않아도 되게 하는 키워드

Global Actor - An actor that you can attach to many types and functions, so all of them run in one shared place.
한국어: Global Actor: 여러 타입과 함수에 붙여서 모두 같은 한 곳에서 실행되게 하는 액터

landscape.hook: Can you explain MainActor, Nonisolated and Global Actor in English?

dialogue.title: The view model warning
dialogue.setting: A view model that updates the screen

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my view model updates the screen from a background task, and Xcode shows a warning.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: UI work belongs on the main thread. Mark the class with MainActor, like `ViewModel` in your code.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: MainActor is a special actor that runs its code on the main thread.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But `id()` does not touch the screen. Do I need await to call it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not if it is nonisolated. Nonisolated lets a member run without isolation.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So callers do not need await for it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. But a nonisolated function cannot read `title`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Makes sense. Can I use MainActor for other types too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. MainActor is a global actor, and a global actor works for many types and functions.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I make my own global actor?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, mark an actor with `@globalActor`. But MainActor is enough for UI.
